tools.name: tradebasis_about
tools.description: What TradeBasis is, the problem it solves, what makes it different, and who it's for. Returns static markdown with an as_of date.

tools.name: tradebasis_pricing_and_tiers
tools.description: TradeBasis subscription tiers — Lite ($99/mo USD) vs Pro ($249/mo USD): what each includes and who each is for. Static markdown.

tools.name: tradebasis_research_library
tools.description: Static research/market-report briefs authored by TradeBasis. Call with no arguments to list available briefs, or pass a topic (slug or title) to retrieve a single brief. Returns static markdown.

tools.name: tradebasis_vin_decode
tools.description: Decode a 17-character VIN into vehicle identity: year, make, model, trim, body style, drivetrain, engine and fuel type. Identification only — this tool returns no valuation, no comparable listings and no market data.
